source_notes: Star identity, ESO skill ID, discipline, maximum points, and passive/slottable classification are Update 50 game-data values cross-checked against ESO Decoded / UESP-derived CP2 data.
jump_points_verified marks stage arrays individually. Unverified stage arrays are retained only as a bundled fallback display hint and are not used as validator authority.
prerequisite_path/path_verified identify offline routes that were explicitly checked. ATTB never treats an unverified empty path as proof that a star is directly purchasable.

Addon 1.1.3+ exports the live ESO Champion graph, root flags, jump points, outer-constellation coordinates, nested-cluster membership, and cluster-local coordinates; live game data takes precedence for routing and locator geometry whenever a current character snapshot is available.
map coordinates are an ATTB schematic fallback for orientation, not copied ESO UI pixels.
